hotels.description: Set in the heart of the Hunter Valley, these apartments place you within easy reach of Pokolbin’s cellar doors, boutique wineries and acclaimed restaurants. The region’s rolling vineyards and scenic drives are on the doorstep, with Hunter Valley Gardens and the Hunter Valley Cheese Factory close by. Each apartment offers a self-contained base with kitchen facilities and living space for longer stays. After a day of tastings, head to nearby Bistro Molines, Muse Kitchen or EXP. Restaurant for modern regional dining, or visit the Lovedale and Rothbury wine trails
